name: 成熟

steps.name: base
steps.prompt: Edit the attached image of the same anime woman (an adult woman in her mid twenties, same face, same eyes, same dark brown-black hair colour, same art style and lighting). {frame} {only_her} {transparent} Change only her outfit, hairstyle and pose as follows: an elegant, tasteful, mature look: an off-the-shoulder soft knit sweater in dusty rose showing her collarbones and shoulders, small drop earrings, long hair swept over one shoulder; she rests her chin on one hand with her head tilted slightly, lowered half-lidded gaze, a faint confident smile, the other forearm folded in front of her at the bottom of the frame. Fully clothed, nothing explicit.

notes: Keep the look modest. The safety filter refuses some faces (shy once, sleepy once); retry, do not reword to get around it.
